title: AgePopDenom: Geostatistical Modeling for Fine-Scale Population Age-Structures
description: An R package that generates high-resolution (5 km x 5 km) estimates of population by single year of age using Demographic and Health Surveys, WorldPop gridded population data, and administrative boundaries.
